description: This file defines a PHP class 'OX_Dal_Maintenance_Statistics_Mysqli' which extends a base class for maintenance statistics, implementing MySQL-specific data handling methods such as managing session variables, migrating raw data, deduplicating conversions, and rejecting empty variable conversions within a database context.

classes.name: OX_Dal_Maintenance_Statistics_Mysqli
classes.description: A MySQL-specific Data Abstraction Layer class for maintenance statistics, handling session variable management, data migration, deduplication, and validation of conversions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class and stores the current MySQL 'sort_buffer_size' session variable.

methods.name: setSortBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the MySQL 'sort_buffer_size' session variable to a configured value if available.

methods.name: restoreSortBufferSize
methods.description: Restores the MySQL 'sort_buffer_size' session variable to its original value.

methods.name: migrateRawRequests
methods.description: Handles migration of raw requests, adjusting session variables before and after parent method call.

methods.name: migrateRawImpressions
methods.description: Handles migration of raw impressions, adjusting session variables before and after parent method call.

methods.name: migrateRawClicks
methods.description: Handles migration of raw clicks, adjusting session variables before and after parent method call.

methods.name: _getMigrateRawDataSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for migrating raw data into bucketed format.

methods.name: deduplicateConversions
methods.description: De-duplicates conversions with associated unique variables within a specified date range.

methods.name: rejectEmptyVarConversions
methods.description: Rejects conversions with empty required variables within a specified date range.
